# FIXTURE SNAPSHOT — structured from first-party research (2026-08-23)

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: WebinarJam hosts live marketing webinars with registration pages, reminders, live chat, polls, and timed offers. EverWebinar replays recorded sessions as simulated-live evergreen funnels with just-in-time scheduling, dynamic attendee counts, and automated follow-up. Both are Genesis Digital products in the Kartra family — affiliate catalogue treats them as one marketing webinar entry. Confirm current packaging on webinarjam.com and everwebinar.com.
VENDOR_POSITIONING: Run live webinars that convert, then automate the winner — WebinarJam for real-time launches, EverWebinar for always-on replay funnels.

NOTES:
WebinarJam (webinarjam.com/pricing, 2026-08-23): $1 trial for 14 days, then paid tiers by attendee cap — Starter ~$49/mo list ($39/mo annual), Basic ~$99 ($79 annual), Professional ~$299 ($229 annual), Enterprise ~$499 ($379 annual). Caps scale from ~100 to 5,000 attendees; host seats vary by tier. EverWebinar (everwebinar.com/pricing): separate flat subscription — $199/mo monthly, $99/mo effective on $1,188 annual prepay, or $79/mo effective on $1,896 two-year prepay; $1 trial then monthly billing. Products are sold separately; Genesis Digital may bundle. Confirm live checkout and affiliate packaging.
